coordinates.mm: Profile X right, Y up, Z front; body-centred. edge_roll_mm=[rear,front].

shelf_correction.reason: All canonical GLBs expose nominal .70 mm outside black glass, but .65 mm front shoulder rolls almost all of it away, leaving only .05 mm nominal flat shelf. Set front .30 and retain rear .65 and glass inset .70, leaving .40 mm flat shelf. This extends the side flat .35 mm toward the front without changing body envelope, glass or OLED.
shelf_correction.support: Official base front image and Pro corner macro distinguish metal lip from black glass/OLED. Same actual geometric defect in all three; existing XL prototype supports directional correction. .30 mm is a visual-fit estimate, NOT a Google measurement.

confidence.precise_front_roll: Low: not a measured physical radius

shelf_correction.preserve: Native OLED resolution/aspect/UV/fit, black glass, rear roll, body dimensions, camera assembly, logo and finish palettes. No outline or optical changes in this patch.

pixel-11.finding: 5-7px colored/reflection band is separate from dark glass and OLED. Does not directly measure flat shelf or fillet. Model .70mm nominal inset is retained, not claimed measured from this photo.
pixel-11.remaining_discrepancy: Launch asset apparent body-to-OLED margins exceed current model margins. Left front is partly obscured and composition is not an engineering drawing; preserve reviewed native OLED mapping and flag parent QA rather than force symmetric margins from it.

pixel-11-pro.finding: Substantial colored lip lies outside black glass and rounds into flat polished side. Supports a flat shelf, but cannot independently establish mm width, fillet radius or full corner contour.

pixel-11-pro-xl.finding: Pro-family design evidence plus prior rendered XL prototype. No independent official XL orthographic front. Procedural frame is not an official dimensional target.

selfie_cutout_audit.existing: All three profiles, procedural SVGs and canonical GLBs use radius1.50mm and a flat black aperture disk. Existing values are estimates, NOT independently measured SDK cutouts.

pixel-11.measurement: Largest 4-connected RGB max<55 component in ROI x699..732,y38..71. Outer darkness includes optical surround and threshold/compression uncertainty.
pixel-11.decision: No optical edit in this shelf patch. Significant mask discrepancy requires parent calibration; do not call existing3mm mask measured. Photo dark surround is not evidence of physical internal lens geometry.

pixel-11-pro.limit: No full front/selfie in inspected Pro references; no independently measured outer aperture. Do not transfer base dimensions.

pixel-11-pro-xl.limit: XL prototype preserved the existing mask, which does not establish accuracy. No full official front/selfie inspected.

selfie_cutout_audit.parent_requirement: Camera internals must fit calibrated outer mask independently from pupils/highlights. All-three measured-mask acceptance remains outstanding; do not treat shelf correction or prior preservation checks as camera calibration.
